## 更新 · What's new

- Mac：大幅降低常驻内存——截图后不再越截越高，主窗口打开时约 260 MB → 85 MB。
  Mac: much lower resident memory — screenshots no longer ratchet memory up; the open main window drops from ~260 MB to ~85 MB.
- 关闭窗口后会真正释放界面；菜单栏面板关闭即释放。
  Closed windows now release their interface; the menu bar panel is freed when it closes.
- 「窗口」菜单新增「关闭窗口 ⌘W」，输入框有焦点时也能关闭。
  Window menu adds Close Window (⌘W), which works even while a text field has focus.
